classification.difficultyReason: Apply the taught horizontal-then-vertical plotting procedure on a supplied labelled grid, using signs for direction and zero coordinates for points on axes.

content.prompt: On a number plane, plot each of the points whose coordinates are given below.

spec.description: Shared editable response plane supplied for the six requested plots. The student source gives coordinates without a printed response plane.
spec.mathematics: Unit grid with x from -6 to 6 and y from -5 to 7; accommodates all six points.
spec.answerVisibility: Axes and grid only; no answer points or point labels.

answer.worked: From the origin, move 1 unit right and 1 unit up. Mark and label $A$.
From the origin, move 2 units right and 3 units down. Mark and label $B$.
The horizontal coordinate is zero. Move 6 units up the $y$-axis and mark $C$.
The vertical coordinate is zero. Move 4 units left along the $x$-axis and mark $D$.
From the origin, move 4 units left and 2 units down. Mark and label $E$.
From the origin, move 4 units left and 5 units up. Mark and label $F$.

spec.sourceRegion: Review exercise question 2; answer evidence teacher PDF page 39
spec.description: One completed coordinate plane with all six labelled points, matching the teacher solution.
